destinationLocationRole.description: Optional declaration of what kind of facility-layout LocationRole this path's completed work is destined for (ADR 0006). Omitted entirely — or the equivalent JSON null / empty string — means no destination role was declared: the default, and most common, case (e.g. Pick has no single destination). Immutable once set at DefinePath time; never revisable via RevisePath. This is declarative routing intent this service publishes for a downstream consumer to interpret — it is never validated against a live facility-layout lookup (this service has zero inbound/outbound dependency on any other context).
destinationLocationRole.title: DestinationLocationRole

cycleTimeP95.description: The operator-declared p95 end-to-end cycle time from release into the path to manifest (ADR 0010): a declared standard, not a measured value. Required and must be positive. Encoded as a Go duration string (e.g. "2h", "90m", "2h30m").
cycleTimeP95.title: CycleTimeP95

eligibility.description: The path's eligibility as stored. Always present on a response; an unconstrained path answers `{}`. `maxUnitsPerLine` is omitted when unbounded, the two attribute arrays are omitted when empty and `nonSortable` is omitted when false.
eligibility.title: EligibilityResponse

items.description: One source of demand that may route work onto a process path (ADR 0034). CUSTOMER_ORDER: order-management order lines. STOCK_TRANSFER: network-inventory-planning transfer legs, planned through wes-work-planning. SLOT_RELOCATION: approved slot-plan moves, planned through wes-work-planning. INVENTORY_CONTROL: internal inventory work (amnesty, damage, problem solve). REPLENISHMENT: pick-face top-ups from pick-face-replenishment, planned through wes-work-planning (ADR 0036); the only source declared on the REPLENISH path.
items.title: DemandSource

intake.description: The demand sources allowed to route work onto this path (ADR 0034), in canonical (sorted) order. Always present; [] when the path is reached only by an explicit path id.

404.description: No process path exists with this id

500.description: An unexpected error (problem type `internal-error`): a storage or other infrastructure failure, or a recovered panic. On `POST /process-paths` a 5xx is never stored under the Idempotency-Key, so a retry with the same key runs again.

schema.description: RFC 7807 Problem Details for HTTP APIs.
